name: motta-statusline
description: Two-line status line: folder, repo link, git state, the branch's PR with CI, conflicts and review, model and effort, a context bar with the auto-compact point, rate limits, how long the prompt cache stays warm, tokens and the generation rate (tokens per second, live while a request streams). Below the prompt (always visible) or as a band above it.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: below: in the hint line under the prompt, visible while Claude works (terminal and desktop). above: a colored band above the prompt that the spinner replaces during a turn and other mods can take over.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after each request. auto: what the engine says on a model switch, or 5m once a fork finds the cache lapsed early; before either, 1h on a Claude subscription (rate limits reported) and 5m otherwise. 5m or 1h to set it.
